title: marks a record from a later version read-only
why: The read-only comparison allowing one version more: a record one version ahead of this build would open as editable, and the first write would drop what this build does not know (docs/compatibility.md, "Your projects").

title: refuses a record from a later version and leaves it as it was
why: The same comparison seen from the write: a rename of a record from the next version would be accepted and the file rewritten.

why: The input spread into the parser's result: a key the build does not know would be kept, and docs/compatibility.md ("Your settings") would be describing what no longer happens.
